channel.title: Wire — DevOps
channel.description: DevOps from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Simplify compliance with the native pre-written policy experience in HCP Terraform
item.description: Teams can now browse HashiCorp-managed pre-written policies, add them to a policy set, and apply common compliance guardrails directly in HCP Terraform. (1 source: hashicorp)

item.title: SolidStart 2: Replaces Vinxi with a Vite 8 and Enters Maintenance as Its Role Winds Down
item.description: SolidStart, a full-stack meta-framework based on SolidJS, has transitioned to version 2.0, improving compatibility with Vite's Environment API. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: MariaDB 13 Expands Oracle Compatibility and Improves Developer Experience and Observability
item.description: MariaDB Community Server 13.0 has reached General Availability (GA) and is now officially stable. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: The Implications of Linguistic Illegibility for LLM Security
item.description: LLMs are trained to generate natural language. However, various strands of evidence indicate that an LLM's externalized linguistic outputs and mechanistically-extracted linguistic features can be an unreliable lens for understanding… (1 source: lobsters)
